title: Composed supervisory control: Two-out-of-three sensor voter -> Mode-dependent command selection

inputs.name: B_AutoMode
inputs.description: Subsystem B: TRUE selects automatic mode

outputs.name: B_Blocked
outputs.description: Subsystem B: A request exists but is blocked

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Vote shall be TRUE when at least two of A_S1, A_S2, and A_S3 are TRUE.
requirements.property: G(A_Vote = ((A_S1 AND A_S2) OR (A_S1 AND A_S3) OR (A_S2 AND A_S3)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Unanimous shall be TRUE only when all three channels have the same value.
requirements.property: G(A_Unanimous = ((A_S1 AND A_S2 AND A_S3) OR ((!A_S1) AND (!A_S2) AND (!A_S3))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Command shall follow B_AutoDemand in automatic mode and B_ManualDemand in manual mode, but only when B_SafetyOK is TRUE and B_Inhibit is FALSE.
requirements.property: G(B_Command = (((B_AutoMode AND B_AutoDemand) OR ((!B_AutoMode) AND B_ManualDemand)) AND B_SafetyOK AND (!B_Inhibit)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Blocked shall be TRUE when the selected request is TRUE but safety is not OK or B_Inhibit is TRUE.
requirements.property: G(B_Blocked = (((B_AutoMode AND B_AutoDemand) OR ((!B_AutoMode) AND B_ManualDemand)) AND ((!B_SafetyOK) OR B_Inhibit)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Vote shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
